command:
set -e
if ! /usr/bin/mountpoint -q /mnt/d; then
  /usr/bin/mkdir -p /mnt/d
  /usr/bin/mount -t drvfs D: /mnt/d -o ro
fi
mount_info=$(/usr/bin/findmnt -n -o SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS --target /mnt/d)
set -- $mount_info
[ "$#" -eq 3 ]
[ "$1" = 'D:' ]
[ "$2" = '9p' ]
case ",$3," in *,ro,*) ;; *) echo 'STOP: D: mount is not read-only' >&2; exit 31;; esac
case ",$3," in *,rw,*) echo 'STOP: D: mount is writable' >&2; exit 32;; esac
repo=/mnt/d/Repo/Virtual_scrum_team
[ -d "$repo" ]
cd "$repo"
branch=$(/usr/bin/git branch --show-current)
head=$(/usr/bin/git rev-parse HEAD)
[ "$branch" = 's2-canonical-continuation' ]
[ "$head" = '7d1d16f6348e6c00a5a568b5cfbc8caf309194b9' ]
for item in \
  'tools/qa/collect_s2_runtime_config_inventory.py 453fe70732c7309158cab7a0876b6bb7347b895056969ef87dbf988dd8cfa838' \
  'tools/qa/verify_s2_runtime_config_inventory.py ad2f1a1f2a5b13f63279e72a53ee27a81ee5d057186a51592dac4d3f7f7ae8d9' \
  'tools/qa/apply_s2_runtime_configuration.py 7d208f72853b72666bd22b7d171d9b29f9bd2a96d77a19affea21f51d3009415' \
  'tools/vst/preflight_host_capture.py 0f3b7b6fe11798ebc806a55bd4d6f687e7974b6f4394b2065e15defab8255083' \
  'docs/sdlc/runtime-config/bundle-manifest.json 388e6bb00f97b54bbd456994ccdd399317ab2e527c6f37d8a1b71ce20a280e45' \
  'docs/sdlc/runtime-config/installation-layout.json 47d3e66f1d765c0b078428708d2d9bf6c0218085714878e11395d164d57d1c19'; do
  set -- $item; path=$1; expected=$2
  actual=$(/usr/bin/git show "HEAD:$path" | /usr/bin/sha256sum | /usr/bin/cut -d ' ' -f1)
  [ "$actual" = "$expected" ]
done
exec /usr/bin/python3 tools/qa/collect_s2_runtime_config_inventory.py
